items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Ned' and the interviewee does not respond with personal anecdotes or confirmation of a direct relationship, only the interviewer's statements are present.

ctx.x: Well I didn't know, I hear him talk about it. My cousin used to play with him, he's from Carlton. Yeah, Joe, I saw a trumpet player.
And I see him talking about a trumpet player called Ned.
What was his name, Ned what? He used to play with Ned.
